title: Doesn't humidify a room
text:
Doesn't humidify a room. It was very quiet, so I'll give it that. It appeared to work like it should and put out lots of mist.

My problem is that my room of just over 200 square feet was not humidified much by this machine (the machine is advertised for 250 square feet). I let it run for a full 24 hours and had a humidity reader next to my bed (four steps away), and it was just barely able to reach 30% after a full 24 hours. I just wanted to run this thing at night!

So the next day I let it run and put the humidity reader on my sink counter about 18 inches away from the machine. It still only was able to get to about 30% humidity, so even if I wanted to move it so that it would mist right next to my head it wouldn't have helped any.

I'm also hesitant about this machine because there's no way to clean the basin where the water sits. The hole is so small you can't even put one of those humidifier cleaning fish inside it (or ever hope to get it out again). So I'm returning this item. I'll look into their larger model, but if I can't clean the water tank in that one either I will probably decide to pass on this brand.
